title: R statistics and plots

```{r}
measurements <- c(3, 7, 11)
mean(measurements)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-measurements
#| fig-cap: Measurements calculated in R
plot(measurements, type = "b", col = "steelblue", pch = 19)
```

R cells share their own session. See @fig-measurements.
